title: 第1745章 恢复九品神血军团大规模集结第1744章 军团整装待发
content_zh:
水界珠内。
李衍道睁开了眼。
密室外堆积的光阴树落叶已厚达数尺，木系法则构筑的密室墙壁上，爬满了从灵田区蔓延过来的混元藤，藤身上的混沌法则光纹，在数千年的光阴中缓缓流转。
土系法则加固过的岩砖地面，被他的体温和法则波动反复浸染，已呈现出一种金银紫三色纹路。
那是至尊法则循环在长年累月运转中，自然渗透进岩层的痕迹。
六层神国在数千年的积累后，已达到了源皇六层的顶峰。
第四层法则大陆边缘新开辟的虚空中，数十门圆满法则的脉络已完全稳固，第五层至尊法则循环的运转速度比闭关前翻了一倍不止，第六层神国的夹层结构，在四道至尊法则分支的支撑下已完全稳固。
六层神国每一层之间的法则衔接紧密到不分彼此。
源力积累已超过了开辟第七层神国的最低门槛。
他没有立即冲击第七层。
三生神血的淬炼也进入了最关键的阶段。
太初神王本源通过封印核心中的至尊法则融合体，渡来的三大至尊法则本源微粒，在数千年的持续淬炼后，已将三生神血推到了八品巅峰的极限。
距离九品只差最后一丝。
那一丝不再需要更多本源微粒的堆积，需要的是三大至尊法则的再次融合。
用他在补封印缺口时领悟的至尊法则融合体，将三生神血中三种古神族血脉重新融合一次，以完整的融合印记推动神血完成最后的质变。
他将左手手背的三生神血纹对准眉心。
金银紫三色光纹从手背延伸到眉心，再从眉心蔓延到全身。
时间法则根须、空间法则根须、轮回法则根须在源海中同时收束，三者的本源脉络在神血核心中再次交织。
一道极小的三色光环在他丹田深处缓缓成形。
和封印核心中那道至尊法则融合体，一模一样的结构，只是缩小了无数倍。

光环成形的那一瞬间，三生神血在血管中猛地发出一声低沉共鸣。
金银紫三色神血光纹，同时爆发出闭关以来最耀眼光芒，三种血脉在至尊法则融合体的催化下，完成了一次极其彻底的分化与再融合。
分化到每一滴神血中三种血脉的占比，都精确地达到了各自的三分之一，再融合到三种血脉之间，不再有任何界限。
水界珠上空雷声隆隆，整个灵田区的法则光晕，都在为九品三生神血的回归而微微震颤。
九品三生神血，在闭关数千年后，于此刻恢复。
李衍道从密室中站起来，推开密室的门。
木系法则构筑的密室墙壁，在他推门的同时，自动分解为最基础的木系法则微粒，回归灵田区的木系法则循环中。
灵田区的源力光晕比闭关前更浓郁了几分，四旺蹲在混沌笼炉前炼完最后一炉六品法则丹，手里捏着李松鹤给他打的那只金系法则加固的铁蜡木茶杯，杯中的茶水还在冒热气。
李法曈站在光阴树下，时空日晷神国瞳孔中的空间古神血透明光芒，已稳稳停在四品巅峰。
距离五品只差最后的临门一脚。
小七从神血池密室中走出来，涅盘火种在她眉心前已恢复到拳头大小，火种表面的暗金纹路，比闭关前更加密集完整，七芒星神国的四层叠加态，已彻底稳固，第五层的骨架，也已在数千年的淬炼中搭建了三分之一。
“九品了？”小七问。
“九品了。”
李衍道伸出手，手背上的三色神血纹在灵田源力光晕的映照下，流转着纯粹的金银紫光，“太初留下的神王本源还在持续渡入，共鸣通道没有关闭。
九品之后还能继续往上推，推到一个连太初都没有达到过的层次。”
他感受着体内三生神血的变化，九品已成，但那股共鸣仍在持续。
太初神王留在封印核心中的本源，似乎远比他预想的更深厚，九品对这股本源来说只是起点而非终点。
未来的路还有很长，但此刻，九品已足够。
“出关。极北冰原的仗，该收网了。”
他一步踏出水界珠。

极北冰原正南方向，血喉站在巨冰顶端，背后的血祭法则光带，在暴风雪中已飘动了数十年。
他等到了，西南方向，骨祭军团的骨祭法则波动，已进入西南分阵台的感应阵盘范围。
东南方向，魂祭军团主力的魂祭法则波动，也已出现在东南分阵台外围。
正南方向，命祭军团的先头部队在远古冰河故道尽头，亮起了暗绿色的命祭光芒。
四支残部从四个方向，同时压向极北冰原防线，冰原上的暴风雪。
content_en:
Inside the Water Boundary Pearl.
Li Yandao opened his eyes.
The fallen leaves of the Time Tree outside the secret room are several feet thick. The walls of the secret room built with the Wood Law are covered with Hunyuan vines that have spread from the Lingtian District. The light patterns of the Chaos Law on the vines have slowly circulated over thousands of years.
The rock brick floor reinforced by the laws of the earth system has been repeatedly stained by the fluctuations of his body temperature and laws, and has shown a pattern of gold, silver and purple.
Those are traces of the cycle of the Supreme Law that has naturally penetrated into the rock formations over the years.
After thousands of years of accumulation, the Six-Level Divine Kingdom has reached the peak of the Six-Level Origin Emperor.
In the newly opened void on the edge of the fourth-level law continent, the veins of dozens of perfect laws have been completely stabilized. The speed of the cycle of the fifth-level supreme law has more than doubled than before the retreat. The mezzanine structure of the sixth-level divine kingdom has been completely stabilized with the support of the four branches of the supreme law.
The laws between each level of the six-level divine kingdom are so closely connected that they are indistinguishable from each other.
The accumulation of source power has exceeded the minimum threshold for opening up the seventh-level divine kingdom.
He did not immediately attack the seventh floor.
The tempering of the Three Lives Divine Blood has also entered the most critical stage.
The origin of the Taichu God King passed through the fusion of the Supreme Law in the core of the seal, and the particles of the origin of the three Supreme Laws, after thousands of years of continuous tempering, have pushed the three-life divine blood to the limit of the eighth-level peak.
It's just the last step away from the ninth level.
That trace no longer requires the accumulation of more original particles, but the reintegration of the three supreme laws.
Using the fusion body of the Supreme Law that he understood when filling the gap in the seal, he re-fused the three bloodlines of the ancient gods in the three lives of the divine blood, and used the complete fusion mark to promote the final qualitative change of the divine blood.
He aimed the blood pattern of the Three Lives Gods on the back of his left hand at the center of his eyebrows.
Gold, silver, and purple light patterns extend from the back of the hand to the center of the eyebrow, and then spread from the center of the eyebrow to the whole body.
The roots of the law of time, the roots of the law of space, and the roots of the law of reincarnation are simultaneously gathered in the source sea, and the original veins of the three are intertwined again in the core of the divine blood.
A tiny three-color halo slowly formed deep in his Dantian.
It has exactly the same structure as the Supreme Law Fusion in the core of the seal, but it has been shrunk countless times.
The moment the halo took shape, the blood of the Three Lives God suddenly made a low resonance in the blood vessels.
The golden, silver and purple divine blood light patterns simultaneously erupted with the most dazzling light since the retreat. Under the catalysis of the fusion of the Supreme Law, the three bloodlines completed an extremely thorough differentiation and refusion.
It differentiated to the point where the proportion of the three bloodlines in each drop of divine blood reached exactly one third of each, and then merged to the point where there was no longer any boundary between the three bloodlines.
Thunder rumbled over the Water Boundary Pearl, and the halo of law in the entire Lingtian District was trembling slightly for the return of the ninth-grade three-life divine blood.
The ninth-grade three-life divine blood was restored at this moment after being in seclusion for thousands of years.
Li Yandao stood up from the secret room and pushed open the door of the secret room.
The secret room wall constructed with the Wood Law automatically decomposed into the most basic Wood Law particles when he opened the door, returning to the Wood Law cycle in Lingtian District.
The halo of source power in Lingtian District was a bit stronger than before the retreat. Siwang squatted in front of the Chaos Cage Furnace and finished refining the last six-grade Law Pill. He held in his hand the golden law-reinforced iron wax wood teacup that Li Songhe had given him. The tea in the cup was still steaming.
Li Fazhuo stood under the tree of time, and the transparent light of the ancient divine blood of space in the pupils of the time and space sundial of the divine kingdom had steadily stopped at the peak of the fourth level.
There is only one final step left before reaching fifth level.
Xiao Qi walked out of the secret room of the divine blood pool. The Nirvana fire had returned to the size of a fist in front of her eyebrows. The dark gold lines on the surface of the fire were denser and more complete than before the retreat. The four-layer superimposed state of the Seven-Pointed Star Divine Kingdom had been completely stabilized, and one-third of the skeleton of the fifth layer had been built through thousands of years of tempering.
"Ninth grade?" Xiao Qi asked.
"Ninth grade."
Li Yandao stretched out his hand, the back of his handThe three-color divine blood pattern on the body is reflected by the halo of the spiritual field's source power, flowing with pure golden, silver and purple light. "The origin of the divine king left behind in the beginning is still flowing in, and the resonance channel has not been closed.
After the ninth level, one can continue to push up, to a level that even Taichu has not reached. "
He felt the changes in the three-life divine blood in his body. He had reached the ninth level, but the resonance still continued.
The origin left in the core of the seal by the Taichu God King seems to be far deeper than he expected. The ninth grade is just the starting point for this origin, not the end.
There is still a long way to go, but at this moment, Grade 9 is enough.
"Get out of the border. It's time to close the net in the battle in the far north ice field."
He stepped out of the Water Boundary Pearl in one step.
Directly south of the extreme northern ice field, Blood Throat stood on the top of the giant ice. The light band of the Blood Sacrifice Law behind him had been fluttering in the snowstorm for decades.
He waited. To the southwest, the Bone Sacrifice Law of the Bone Sacrifice Legion fluctuated and entered the induction array range of the southwest sub-array station.
To the southeast, the Soul Sacrifice Law fluctuations of the main force of the Soul Sacrifice Legion have also appeared on the periphery of the southeastern formation.
Directly south, the vanguard of the Life Sacrifice Legion lit up a dark green Life Sacrifice light at the end of the ancient glacier path.
The four remnant troops pressed against the defense line of the far north ice field from four directions at the same time, and there was a blizzard on the ice field.
